description: Rows cascade in, a sortable header's arrow turns over on a spring and reports the sort to screen readers, and selected rows fade in. On a phone it scrolls sideways with a soft edge.
keyboard: Moves between the sort buttons, checkboxes and links in the table.
Sorts by the focused column, or turns its sort over.
Sorts by the focused column, or ticks the focused row's checkbox.

propDocs.TableHead.sort: Controlled ascending, descending, or none; undefined makes the header static.
propDocs.TableHead.defaultSort: How this column is sorted at first, when you don't control `sort`. Makes the header a sort button that keeps its own sort.
propDocs.TableHead.onSort: Called when the sort button is pressed.
propDocs.TableHead.onSortChange: Runs when the sort changes, with the next direction and the change's details (`reason`, `source`, `cancel()`). Makes the header a sort button.
propDocs.TableRow.selected: Marks the row selected and applies its selection tint.

cssVars: --foreground at 3% on hover and 6% when selected
